note: Public analytical tests, not the hosted platform factor catalogue or scoring weights.

core.title: Entity and ownership
core.test: Resolve legal identity, jurisdiction, ownership and instruments; distinguish operating entity from brand.

core.title: Customer problem and demand
core.test: Test urgency, alternatives, willingness to pay and demonstrated adoption.

core.title: Product and execution
core.test: Assess current readiness, delivery evidence, differentiation and critical dependencies.

core.title: Team and governance
core.test: Verify relevant track record, responsibilities, key-person dependency, conflicts and governance.

core.title: Market and competition
core.test: Test reachable market, competitors, substitutes, channels and pricing; distinguish top-down TAM from addressable sales.

core.title: Revenue and economics
core.test: Reconcile actual revenue and cost structure, monetisation, contribution and repeatability.

core.title: Cash and capital
core.test: Test cash availability, financing, burn, debt, working capital, runway and future funding needs.

core.title: Defensibility
core.test: Test durability of differentiation, switching costs, IP rights, scale effects and replication risks.

core.title: Regulatory and operational risks
core.test: Identify material licensing, compliance, operational, security and concentration dependencies.

core.title: Thesis and valuation drivers
core.test: Identify evidence that would invalidate the thesis; determine valuation eligibility and key drivers.

saas.title: Recurring revenue quality
saas.test: Contracted recurring revenue versus bookings and one-off services; ARR bridge.

saas.title: Retention and acquisition
saas.test: Cohorts, GRR/NRR, churn, CAC and payback with consistent definitions.

saas.title: Scalability
saas.test: Hosting and service costs, contribution, support and enterprise sales cycle.

marketplace.title: Liquidity and repeat usage
marketplace.test: Match rate, time to match, repeat demand and supply density by market.

marketplace.title: GMV and monetisation
marketplace.test: Recognised revenue versus GMV, take rate, incentives, refunds and fraud.

marketplace.title: Network resilience
marketplace.test: Concentration, multihoming, disintermediation and local-market economics.

manufacturing.title: Capacity and yield
manufacturing.test: Rated versus effective capacity, utilisation, throughput, scrap and quality.

manufacturing.title: Capital and working capital
manufacturing.test: Capex maintenance, inventory, receivables, payables and cash conversion.

manufacturing.title: Supply and execution
manufacturing.test: Supplier dependence, order quality, delivery, warranties and certifications.

consumer.title: Repeat demand
consumer.test: Repeat purchase cohorts, returns and channel concentration.

consumer.title: Channel contribution
consumer.test: Net selling price, promotions, fulfilment, marketplace fees and CAC.

consumer.title: Inventory
consumer.test: Stock turns, obsolescence, supply lead time and working capital.

lending.title: Credit performance
lending.test: Vintage losses, delinquencies, recoveries and underwriting quality.

lending.title: Funding and capital
lending.test: Cost of funds, liquidity, mismatch, leverage and regulatory capital.

lending.title: Risk-adjusted economics
lending.test: Net interest, acquisition, servicing and expected losses; licensing.

biotech.title: Clinical evidence
biotech.test: Trial phase, endpoints, comparator, safety, independent scientific support.

biotech.title: Regulatory and IP
biotech.test: Approval path, patent scope, freedom to operate and milestone dependencies.

biotech.title: Capital to milestones
biotech.test: Trial/manufacturing costs, probability and timing assumptions, financing risk.

deeptech.title: Technical validation
deeptech.test: Independent test results, reproducibility, readiness and scaling bottlenecks.

deeptech.title: Commercialisation
deeptech.test: Paid pilots versus signed interest, certification, integration and lead times.

deeptech.title: IP and capital
deeptech.test: Ownership, protectability, manufacturing transfer and milestone funding.

services.title: Delivery economics
services.test: Utilisation, effective billing rate, direct labour and project contribution.

services.title: Repeat and concentration
services.test: Backlog, contracted scope, renewals, collection and client dependency.

services.title: Scalability
services.test: Hiring, knowledge transfer, capacity constraints and quality control.

other.title: Model-specific economics
other.test: Describe unit of value, revenue recognition, variable costs and bottleneck.

other.title: Model-specific risk
other.test: Identify major dependencies and tests that standard categories do not capture.
